title: Treasury liquidity-support buyback operation (TIPS 10-30Y, $500M cap, 1:40pm ET)
source: TSY: the operation ran and is a matter of published record — three treasurydirect.gov/treasury.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-16, all HTTP 200 on a plain curl. (1) Preliminary announcement instit/annceresult/press/preanre/2026/BBPA_20260915174000.xml, announcementDTM 2026-09-14T11:00:00-04:00, titled 'TREASURY TIPS BUYBACK OPERATION PRELIMINARY ANNOUNCEMENT': maxParAmountRedeemed 500000000, numberIssuesEligible 16, maturityDateRangeBegin 2040-02-15, maturityDateRangeEnd 2056-02-15, operation 2026-09-15 13:40-14:00 ET, settlement 2026-09-16. (2) Final announcement BBA_20260915174000.xml, announcementDTM 2026-09-15T11:00:00-04:00, cap and eligible count unchanged. (3) Results BBR_20260915174000.xml, corroborated line-for-line by api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov buybacks_operations and buybacks_security_details: totalParAmountOffered 2088000000, totalParAmountAccepted 500000000, numberIssuesAccepted 6 of 16 — the first cap fill in this bucket's history and the largest par offered into any long-TIPS buyback under either the current '10Y to 30Y' label or the predecessor '7.5Y to 30Y'. The prior EST: label recorded a taxonomy gap (a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and the confirming primary is the operation announcement rather than the schedule PDF); that gap closed on 09-14 and the operation executed on 09-15, so the confirmed prefix is now the honest one. Flipped at close-out 2026-09-16
notes: PROMOTED to canonical 2026-09-08 by this event's own initial research, from the single proposal that existed for this id (proposals/treasury-buyback-tips-10y30y-2026-09-15.from-treasury-buyback-increase-2026-09-09.json, filed the same day by the 09-09 buyback-increase D-1 sweep). Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-buyback-tips-10y30y-2026-09-15.md. The proposer's read is upheld and sharpened on three primary-verified counts. (1) sb0607 (fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200, full body read) does NOT cover this operation: its title is 'Nominal Long-End Liquidity Support Buybacks' and its body names 'longer-dated nominal coupon securities (the 10-year to 20-year sector and the 20-year to 30-year sector)' only. The $500M cap here is untouched, so this is the doubled window's control. (2) The cap has never been the binding constraint, but the proposer's 'never came close' understates WHY: across all four operations under the current 10Y-30Y label (2025-11-12, 2025-12-23, 2026-03-25, 2026-05-28) offers EXCEEDED the $500M cap every time (1.5x-2.8x) and Treasury still accepted only $142M/$108M/$110M/$91M, an 18.2-28.4% fill and a 9.1-14.5% hit rate on par offered. Treasury is rationing on PRICE, not running out of sellers — the exact inverse of the nominal long end, where the cap bound 25/25 and 24/26. (3) The label is a maturity range, not a sector: every eligible line in all four operations (15-16 lines, buybacks_security_details, fetched 2026-09-08) is a Feb-15 maturity between 2040 and 2055 — the 30-year TIPS strip, zero 10-year TIPS lines, because the window opens one day after the newest 10Y TIPS matures. Two further facts this research adds: 110 days will have elapsed since the last long-TIPS operation (2026-05-28), the longest gap in the series since it began 2024-04-17; and this is the ONLY TIPS 10Y-30Y operation on the entire August-2026 refunding schedule (the other two TIPS rows, 9/29 and 10/21, are the 1Y-10Y bucket at $750M, proposed here). Low impact is honest about size — $500M against $8.0B of 30Y TIPS issued on 2026-08-20 alone is a 16:1 issuance-to-cap ratio — not about analytical value: this is the one operation in the 09-10 to 09-24 corridor that touches the instrument the long-end selloff is actually happening in. Estimate-labeled; nothing here licenses an entry. | CLOSE-OUT 2026-09-16: status flipped estimate -> confirmed on the three announcement/results primaries above. The operation printed $2,088M offered / $500M accepted / 100% fill / 6 of 16 issues — the cap bound for the FIRST time under this label, killing forward test FT-treasury-buyback-tips-10y30y-2026-09-15-1 (which predicted an accepted take under $250M) while its sibling -2 passed at 2.3x its bar. The finding that outlives this event, banked to docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md's kill list: pooled across all 15 long-TIPS operations since 2024-04-17 (both labels), fill of cap tracks PAR OFFERED rather than any fixed Treasury reservation posture — every operation with >= $1.49B offered filled >= 81% of cap (6 of 6, five at 100%), every one with <= $1.40B filled <= 65% (8 of 8), with one boundary counter-case at $1,392M / 28.4% on 2025-11-12. Point (2) of the notes above is therefore superseded as a forward claim and kept as the record of what was believed at D-7. Points (1) and (3) both HELD at the one place each could have failed: the revised schedule Treasury owed sb0607 published 2026-09-09 (masthead 'For Publication September 9, 2026', 89,250 bytes, md5 c49a5351bf2d31a367817abc62be51bd) and left the TIPS rows at $500M/$750M while every nominal long-end row became '= or > $4 billion'; and the announced maturity range began 2040-02-15, which is Treasury publishing the front of the bucket as the first real Feb-15 TIPS maturity rather than the schedule's rule-derived 09/16/2036. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-buyback-tips-10y30y-2026-09-15.md -> ## Outcome. Stand-aside stance held and cost nothing.
